reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Naive-age mapping, bilateral/unilateral deprivation, onset and reverse-occlusion recovery with ordinal ocular response scoring.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation and transfer check of previous primary Methods, supplements or a validated technical protocol is proposed. Local pilots, welfare approval and promises to fill unknown settings do not meet this separate requirement.

Core exposure duration/intensity, stimulus timing and cortical acquisition/response settings remain a list to select later, without executable quantitative settings or a sufficiently specified calibration-to-setting procedure.

Optical/stimulus and response calibration is named, but quantitative acceptance-to-action thresholds or a concrete derivation of tolerances for eye isolation, delivered contrast and mapping reliability are absent.
Animal/cluster replication and pilot variability are recognized, but no quantitative power or interval-width target is linked to the meaningful effect and independent-unit variance.
Contrasts and clustering are recognized, but the actual response/distribution model, assumption diagnostics and specified multiplicity policy remain incomplete.
Age, exposure dose and stimulus-parameter exploration has no bounded candidate grid or objective range-selection/search-stop rule before locking.
Troubleshooting does not explicitly connect technical changes to a revised frozen procedure and fresh independent confirmation; ordinary initial pilot separation is insufficient.
No complete raw-animal/unit-to-output manifest with calibration records, exact analysis versions/settings and all exclusions/deviations is specified.

checks.quote: age-matched animals given a short period of normal vision
checks.reason: The naive-at-eye-opening group and animals with 1-2 weeks normal vision are called age-matched despite different endpoint ages. One factual deduction remains. Audit correction: the lid-only phrase was a comparison between the two chosen deprivation modes (lid closure versus dark rearing), not a denial that reversible optical alternatives exist; remove that overbroad deduction.

An experience-dependent emergence/absence contrast establishes a developmental requirement but does not uniquely distinguish instructive construction from permissive maturation. A specific imposed-input-to-result mapping is needed for that stronger mechanism.

Ordinal eye categories lack operational quantitative class boundaries and a defined weak/unresponsive-unit treatment; unit mappability is reported but cannot supply the missing ocular classification rule.

The proposed early-success stop is not translated into a registered numerical decision/spending rule; an informal unambiguous-discrimination judgment can stop a favorable sequence. Conditional-power futility alone does not repair it.

Meaningful experience/competition question and justified continuity-of-model gate. Age/sham, eye-specific stimulation, peripheral/earlier-stage checks and anatomical sampling are prospective; specific overidentification and factual errors are assessed under G4/G1, not duplicated.

historical_match_reason: The unilateral-versus-normal/sham comparison predicts open-eye dominance with eye-specific cortical recording and mandatory peripheral/earlier-stage validation. This positive core matches all five sealed components. Errors in secondary naive-age/construction branches reduce quality without automatically nullifying this separately valid historical experiment.
